rules.critical: A CRITICAL violation withholds the game: it is not inferred, not published and not decided (docs/cfb-production/CANONICAL.md §3). The champion is never run on a silent default.
rules.null: REFUSE: a null is a CRITICAL violation (the model would impute it silently). ALLOWED_BEFORE_FIRST_GAME: a null is accepted only while min_games == 0 (as in training, where these four fields are null in week 1 and only then); otherwise CRITICAL.
rules.range: HARD range (CRITICAL outside it) = the training [min, max] widened by half the span on each side, intersected with the declared natural bounds (binary {0,1}, min 0, rest_diff clipped to [-14, 14]). SOFT range = the training [p01, p99]: values outside it are legitimate extremes, counted by the feature monitor, never refused.
rules.type: number: finite float; binary: exactly 0 or 1; anything else (text, inf) is CRITICAL.
rules.timestamps: feature_ts <= kickoff_ts and prediction_ts <= kickoff_ts (UTC); a snapshot whose inputs post-date kickoff is CRITICAL.
rules.monitor: The feature monitor compares a slate with the training reference of its season phase (mean shift in reference SDs, SD ratio, share outside the soft range, missingness). It flags; it never refits, clips or changes an input.
